questions.question: Can every active requirement be traced to a milestone, journey or explicit engineering test?
Are any Phase 2/3 or deferred extension capabilities accidentally required by Phase 1?
Can the same table QR safely resolve to cloud or outlet node without browser-security warnings?
Is the outlet authority model sufficient to prevent split-brain, including emergency replacement?
Are local/cloud identifiers, idempotency, authority sequence and dependency ordering specified clearly?
Are bill, tip, payment, service charge and tax structurally separate?
Does Arabic RTL receive executable mixed-direction, ETB, numeral and receipt coverage rather than string substitution?
Are tenant/outlet boundaries enforceable using exact production roles?
Can backup/restore and production images be tested without host-only dependencies?
Can every CI job fail honestly when tests are skipped, undiscovered, stale or unsupported?
Is the build graph executable milestone-by-milestone using only approved predecessors?
Is any v1.1 or deferred-module assumption silently retained?
Are 5-second proofs, 10-second degradation, 20-second lease expiry, three-proof recovery and asymmetric LAN service independently specified and testable?
Are cash, external-terminal recording and verified Telebirr/CBE Birr proof confirmation live pilot paths while direct provider APIs remain simulator-only?
